title: About this template
intro: A monorepo template. Each library and channel has its own visible proof on the Home page.

stack.router: react-router-dom: this page is a second route.
stack.i18n: react-i18next: every text here comes from a JSON namespace.
stack.zustand: zustand: the theme you chose stays when you change route.
stack.tailwind: Tailwind v4: styles come from shared tokens in @repo/tailwind-config.
